comment: Today, the meal on now: the prominent button that records the meal as eaten. An action, not a state. Short, fits beside Skip.
Today timeline: swipe and context-menu action that records a meal as eaten. One or two words.
VoiceOver label of a timeline row's status circle, which records the meal as eaten. %@ is the meal's name, e.g. 'Caesar salad'.
Heading above a day's timeline of meals, on a day other than today.
Heading above today's timeline of meals.
VoiceOver label of a timeline meal that moved because the day started late. %1$@ is the usual description ('Lunch, 3:30 PM, Caesar salad, next meal'), %2$@ the plan's time, %3$@ the new time.
Today, under the meal in front: small assistant button that opens step-by-step cooking for the meal. Title Case, short.
Today, under the meal in front, when the day started late and the meal moved: the time the plan gives it. %@ is a clock time, e.g. '08:00'.
Today, last line under the meal in front: the meal after it. %1$@ is its time (with a weekday when it is on another day), %2$@ its name, e.g. 'Then 16:30 · Apple and almonds'.
Today, beside a small progress bar under the meal on now: how long it stays in front. %@ is a duration, e.g. '40 min' or '1 hr, 5 min'.
Today, a light row at the top in the morning before the first meal: asks whether the person is up. Friendly, short.
Today, under 'Good morning — up already?'. %1$@ is the first meal's type ('Breakfast'), %2$@ its time ('08:00'). Explains that a late wake moves the day's meals.
en: %1$@ is at %2$@. Up later than that? Your meals move with you.
tr: %1$@ saati: %2$@. Daha geç mi kalktın? Öğünlerin seninle birlikte kayar.
es: %1$@: %2$@. ¿Te levantas más tarde? Tus comidas se mueven contigo.

comment: Today morning row: button the person taps when they are up; the day's meals follow their wake time. Title Case, very short.
Today morning row: link that opens a time picker to say the person got up earlier than now. Ends with an ellipsis because it opens a sheet.
Today, card at the top when the first meal's time passed long ago and nothing is marked. %1$@ is the first meal's type ('Breakfast'), %2$@ its planned time ('08:00').
Today, late-start card, under the title: what shifting the day does. Calm, no promises about health.
en: Your meals can move to fit the rest of today. Dinner stays close to its time.
tr: Öğünlerin günün geri kalanına göre kayabilir. Akşam yemeği saatine yakın kalır.
es: Tus comidas pueden moverse para encajar en el resto del día. La cena se queda cerca de su hora.

comment: Today, late-start card: main button that moves today's meals to after the person got up (now). Title Case, short.
Today, late-start card: second button that keeps the plan's times and stops the question for today. Title Case.
Today, late-start card: link that opens a picker to say when the person actually got up. Ends with an ellipsis because it opens a sheet.
VoiceOver label of a row in the preview of a moved day. %1$@ is the meal type ('Lunch'), %2$@ the plan's time, %3$@ the new time.
VoiceOver label of a row in the preview of a moved day, for a meal that keeps its time. %1$@ is the meal type ('Dinner'), %2$@ its time.
Today, banner under the meals heading, and a short confirmation, when today's meals moved because the day started late. %@ is a duration, e.g. '1 hr, 30 min'.
es: Tu día se movió %@ más tarde

comment: Today, second line of the 'Day moved' banner: when the person said they got up. %@ is a clock time ('09:40').
Today, second line of the 'Day moved' banner, when the day moved because the first meal was marked eaten late.
en: It follows when you had your first meal.
tr: İlk öğününü yediğin saate göre ayarlandı.
es: Sigue la hora de tu primera comida.

comment: Today, 'Day moved' banner: button that puts today's meals back at the plan's times. Title Case, one or two words.
VoiceOver hint of the Undo button in the 'Day moved' banner.
en: Puts today's meals back at the plan's times.
tr: Bugünün öğünlerini plandaki saatlere geri alır.
es: Vuelve a poner las comidas de hoy a las horas del plan.

comment: Title of the small sheet where the person picks when they got up today. Title Case.
Label of the time picker in the wake-up sheet (read by VoiceOver).
es: Hora a la que te levantaste

comment: Footer under the wake-up time picker: how the day's meals are laid out from the wake time.
en: Your first meal goes half an hour after you got up. The rest of the day follows, and dinner stays close to its time.
tr: İlk öğünün kalktıktan yarım saat sonraya alınır. Günün geri kalanı onu izler, akşam yemeği saatine yakın kalır.
es: Tu primera comida pasa a media hora después de levantarte. El resto del día la sigue y la cena se queda cerca de su hora.

comment: Section header in the wake-up sheet, above the day's meals with their old and new times.
Wake-up sheet: confirm button that records the wake time and moves the day. Title Case, short.
Wake-up sheet: button that closes it without changing anything.
Short toast after a meal is marked eaten, like a friendly 'enjoy your meal'. Two or three words.
Short toast after 'I'm Up' when the person is on time and nothing moves.
en: Good morning! Your meals stay on time.
es: ¡Buenos días! Tus comidas siguen a su hora.

comment: Short toast after choosing to keep the plan's times on a late start.
es: Se mantienen las horas del plan

comment: Short toast after undoing a moved day: the meals are back at the plan's times.
es: De vuelta a las horas del plan

comment: Today, heading of the card that adds up today's meals (energy and macros). Describes the plan, never a remaining budget.
Heading of the card that adds up a day's meals, on a day other than today.
Planned-today card, under the day's total: how much of it the meals marked eaten add up to. %@ is an energy amount, e.g. '640 kcal' or '≈ 640 kcal'.
Planned-today card: label over the protein bar. One word.
Planned-today card: label over the carbohydrates bar. One short word.
Planned-today card: label over the fat bar. One word.
Planned-today card, under a macro bar: grams eaten so far out of grams planned. %1$@ and %2$@ are amounts like '42 g' and '118 g'.
Planned-today card footnote when only some meals have nutrition figures. %1$lld meals with figures out of %2$lld meals, the second always 2 or more.
en: From %1$lld of %2$lld meals; the others have no figures.
es: De %1$lld de %2$lld comidas; las demás no tienen cifras.

comment: Today, assistant card title: offers to work out the nutrition the plan does not give. %lld is the number of distinct meals without figures.

es.many: Añade la nutrición de tus %lld comidas
es.other: Añade la nutrición de tus %lld comidas

comment: Today, assistant card subtitle: what the estimate does and how it is shown. Must keep the ≈ sign.
en: The assistant estimates calories, protein, carbs and fat from each meal's name. Shown with ≈; your dietitian's own figures are never changed.
tr: Asistan her öğünün adından kalori, protein, karbonhidrat ve yağı tahmin eder. ≈ ile gösterilir; diyetisyeninin verdiği değerler asla değişmez.
es: El asistente estima calorías, proteínas, carbohidratos y grasas a partir del nombre de cada comida. Se muestran con ≈; las cifras de tu dietista nunca cambian.

comment: Today, capsule on the assistant card: what tapping costs before tapping. %lld is how many AI uses are left this month.

en.one: One AI use · %lld left this month
en.other: One AI use · %lld left this month

tr.one: 1 asistan hakkı · bu ay %lld hakkın kaldı
tr.other: 1 asistan hakkı · bu ay %lld hakkın kaldı

es.one: 1 uso del asistente · te queda %lld este mes
es.many: 1 uso del asistente · te quedan %lld este mes
es.other: 1 uso del asistente · te quedan %lld este mes

comment: Today, capsule on the assistant card when this month's free uses are used up: tapping explains DietFlow Plus.
Today, small button under the assistant card (and on its failed state) that hides it.
Today, assistant card while it works out nutrition. %lld is the number of distinct dishes being estimated.
Today, assistant card when the estimate is done. %lld is the number of meals that got figures.
Today, button that closes the 'Nutrition added' card.
Today, assistant card when the estimate could not be done.
es: No se pudo añadir la nutrición

comment: Today, assistant card when the estimate failed: nothing was counted against the allowance.
en: The assistant couldn't be reached. Nothing was counted; try again in a moment.
tr: Asistana ulaşılamadı. Hakkından düşülmedi; birazdan tekrar dene.
es: No se pudo contactar con el asistente. No se ha contado ningún uso; inténtalo de nuevo en un momento.

comment: Today, button on the failed assistant card that tries the estimate again.
Today, title of the card about the paid tier. %@ is the app's name; reads 'DietFlow Plus'.

Today, card about the paid tier, for free users: what it adds and that the rest stays free. No price. %1$lld recipes, %2$lld nutrition estimates, %3$lld written plans a month (all large numbers, e.g. 120, 100, 60).
en: More from the assistant every month: %1$lld recipes, %2$lld nutrition estimates and %3$lld written plans, and room for more than one plan. Your plan, widgets and reminders stay free either way.
tr: Her ay asistandan daha fazlası: %1$lld tarif, %2$lld besin değeri tahmini ve %3$lld plan yazımı, üstelik birden fazla plan tutabilirsin. Planın, widget'ların ve hatırlatmaların her durumda ücretsiz kalır.
es: Más del asistente cada mes: %1$lld recetas, %2$lld estimaciones de nutrición y %3$lld planes escritos, y espacio para más de un plan. Tu plan, tus widgets y tus recordatorios siguen siendo gratis.

comment: Today, button on the Plus card that opens the screen describing Plus and its prices. Title Case.
VoiceOver label of the close button on Today's Plus card. Closed once, it does not come back.
Today, small line on the calm card that shows tomorrow's first meal once today's meals are over.
Today, one folded row standing for the meals earlier today whose time went by unmarked; tapping shows them. %lld is how many meals it holds (3 or more).
VoiceOver value of the folded 'Earlier today' row while its meals are hidden.
VoiceOver value of the 'Earlier today' row while its meals are shown.
